data.name: Berty
data.gender_notes: Berty is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Berthold, meaning bright, shining, glorious, or famous. In Christian tradition, Berthold is a name of reverence for the god Bertholdus, the god of protection and strength. The name Berty carries the meaning “Bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berty usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires brightness and light, symbolizing the inner radiance of one's spirit.
data.etymology: Berty belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Berty total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Berty: Bright guardian, shining beacon of protection and hope. A reminder of the divine light that illuminates even the darkest corners of our lives.
